purpose: Test whether counting all eligible loads inside the guarded run can detect a stale ELF-bound address profile, including a change in visit frequencies at two already observed load sites.
profile: Reuse the six frozen #81 profiles, confirm their selected offsets with fresh full calibration inputs, and report agreement descriptively. All scored and audit runs on those six ELFs use the exact archived profile bytes even when the fresh selection differs. Acquire the seventh ELF's offsets from its single full path_mix/train input using the same 95% first-input visit threshold and 64-site limit. No held input may select an offset. All seven calibration/confirmation executions are separate from scored runs.
schedule: Pin the child and workflow owner as in #81 on the same AMD Milan logical CPU. Pair four arms live, full, profiled, guarded by input and repetition. Eight scored repetitions, using two balanced four-period Williams cycles, for each of 11 held inputs. Preserve all observations. After these rounds, audit conditional execution on three extra fresh inputs.
decision: Read the selected sample and same-process omitted-load sidecar from the guarded process. If total eligible loads is zero, return insufficient coverage. Otherwise accept exactly when 10 * selected_visits >= 9 * (selected_visits + omitted_visits); equality at 90% passes. Reject any invalid/inconsistent evidence. The results have diagnostic authority.
integrity: Independently recompute every decision from the selected schema-2 receipt and the guarded omitted-load counter. Compare it with the full run at the same case and repetition: guarded and profiled ordered (offset, visits, completed pairs) must both equal the projection of full onto the frozen ELF offsets; the absolute selected total must match; guarded omitted must equal the exact sum of all unselected full visits; and guarded total must equal full visits. Report mismatches and independently validate per-process receipt/clock identity. Near/far counts and spans from independent processes may vary with virtual addresses; report descriptive differences.
controls: For path_switch, use its independently derived expected hot site and visit/pair/address counts on the calibration, same-path and disjoint inputs. For path_mix, both load sites are visited on both inputs. Require both positive oracle rows in the first full run, only the first offset selected, and the exact two oracle rows on held full runs. The held profile carries the first site's 400,000 visits; the guard must count the other's 7,600,000 visits. Require acceptance on the stable path, rejection on both the disjoint (zero selected) and shifted (positive selected) controls. Report actual full retained-visit coverage on the eight real held inputs; these have no assumed outcome.

cost.statistics: For each scored comparison keep every case and repetition. Primary CPU is measured child wait4 user plus system CPU and parent process CPU over the operational workflow including common ELF preflight, profile lookup and any guarded classification. Also report child-only CPU, corresponding elapsed workflow wall, and ordinary baseline CPU if unprofiled live/full can omit the common hash. Never count a component timer twice. Report pooled on/base from summed CPU, signed paired differences and median/range of paired ratios.
cost.gates: Apply to the eight real inputs and the three control inputs as separate populations. For guarded versus full require >=3% pooled saving and <=2% regression on each input; versus live require <=5% overall overhead and <=10% per case. Use exact sums before rounding. Repeat thresholds using the ordinary baseline sensitivity. Report pass/fail irrespective of integrity outcomes. These are single-execution timing comparisons; a rejected guard provides no accepted sampled report.
cost.groups: Also report the three control input ratios separately and all eleven pooled as descriptive values. Do not infer cross-machine time accuracy.

recovery.projected: For each scored guarded run estimate diagnostic delivery cost as guarded CPU alone when accepted, otherwise guarded CPU plus the matched separately scored full-run CPU. Label this projection and report totals/ratios versus always-full for each input, real, controls and all. Do not count these as additional executed recovery jobs.
recovery.observed: After the scored rounds run three fresh guard workflows on path_switch/same, path_switch/switch and path_mix/shift. On a low-coverage decision actually rerun a full sampler on the identical binary/input and link each new PID and receipt. For a passing audit require guarded to be delivered without a fallback. For a failing audit require a fresh valid full receipt with the independent oracle before delivery. Report actual component CPU and total charged CPU, counter fidelity, decisions and resulting report source per job. Do not pool these one-off audit costs into the balanced timing estimates.

limits: Eligible visits are the specified main-module scalar-read events. Passing this guard measures the visited fraction, not instruction timing or cache misses. Research measurements here do not qualify trusted grading.
